745160101.text: Honorary Knight and The Helper in White, good news!

745160102.text: This is Enghiene of the Maison Gardiennage. She has already arrested the supplier behind The Unchained.

745160103.text: Hmph! The scoundrel was still counting money even as I kicked the door down... A proper piece of work, that one!

745160104.text: And it looks like your fishing spree's had the desired effect — there's been a clear reduction in the number of invasive species in these waters...

745160105.text: The way things are going, I'd say it won't take long before the problem's been thoroughly dealt with.

745160106.text: That's awesome! So, there's no need to worry about the Fonta... Uhh, Paimon meant, the quality of Fontaine's water!

745160107.text: #You're clearly a very capable hunter! It's not just anyone who can enlist the help of {NICKNAME}, the Grand Chef Supreme of Valor...

745160108.text: How does that old phrase go...? That's right, like shooting gulls with a cannon!

745160111.text: Now that Paimon thinks about it, Officer Enghiene looks a little familiar...

745160112.text: Is it because we're always helping uphold the peace? Paimon must have seen a million officers by now!
